name: reviewtool
description: Review articles and provide feedback on Chinese Wikipedia.

scripts.check:annotation: tsc --noEmit --strict --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --skipLibCheck --target ES2017 --module ESNext --moduleResolution node --lib ES2017,DOM src/annotation/index.ts && eslint "src/annotation/**/*.ts" --no-inline-config
scripts.demo:annotation: npm run prepare:annotation-pages && node tests/annotation/build.mjs && node tests/annotation/serve.mjs
scripts.test:annotation:articles: npm run prepare:annotation-pages && node tests/annotation/build.mjs && node --test tests/annotation/articles.check.mjs tests/annotation/pages.check.mjs
scripts.check:live: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2020 --module ESNext --moduleResolution node --lib ES2020,DOM --types types-mediawiki,node global.d.ts src/mediawiki.ts src/mediawiki-dry-run.ts src/annotation/live.ts && eslint "src/mediawiki*.ts" "src/annotation/live*.ts" src/dev-entry.ts src/main.ts src/state.ts --no-inline-config
